clips.text: Here comes the rain! Touch the water and watch the little ripples. Let's come inside the ark.
Welcome aboard! Let's make the ark cozy. You can explore the supplies, animal cabin, and lantern loft.
Every basket needs a safe place. Pick up the basket and carry it to the glowing cradle.
Hold the round rope handle. Pull it down until the knot is nice and snug.
Slide both wooden shutters toward the middle. Listen to the soft clunk when they close.
Let's bring some light inside. Carry the lantern up to the glowing hook. Beautiful!
The supplies are secure, and the lantern is glowing. We're ready to watch the ark float!
The rain came, and the waters rose. Look! The water is lifting the ark. God kept Noah and everyone inside safe.
We're afloat! The ark gently rocks on the waves. Let's check on our little friends and keep everyone cozy.
Three little apples are rolling around! Catch them one at a time and put them back in the basket.
Our little lamb would like something soft. Carry the blanket over to its woolly back.
Use your finger to gently stroke the lamb's wool. Slowly, softly. You're helping our friend settle down.
Lovely work! This room is cozy. Explore another room to see who needs a little help.
Everyone is cozy and cared for. Noah trusted God, and you helped care for the ark. What a wonderful beginning to the voyage!
Ropes hold our supplies in place when the ark moves. Small acts of care can make a big difference.
You can move the wooden viewing handle to peek outside. Watch the waves, then come back into the warm ark.
